rows.name: resource_mediation

rows.name: pytest_registration_and_collection

rows.name: retained_streaming
rows.required: Same-handle bounded verification/read_code/read_range, cache/range/PE limits and large-image native fixtures.

rows.name: fresh_census_release_and_complete_gate
